test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following languages does NOT enjoy the status of a Scheduled language of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Garhwali.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Garhwali **is an **Indo-Aryan language** of the Central Pahari subgroup.
 
• It is firstly spoken by over **2.5 million Garhwali people in the Garhwal region **of the northern Indian state of Uttarakhand in the Indian Himalayas. 
 
• Garhwali has many regional dialects.
 
• Garhwali is as well spoken by Garhwali migrants to other parts of **India as well as ****Himachal** **Pradesh****, Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, and Uttar Pradesh. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Maithili **is an Indo-Aryan language spoken in parts of India and Nepal. 
 
• **Dogri** is a **Northern Indo-Aryan language** spoken by about five million people in India, mainly in the Jammu region of **Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• **Nepali, **also known as Gorkhali, is an **Indo-Aryan language of the sub-branch of Eastern Pahari.****​ **
